name: ArtifactCard
label: Artifact card
description: The tile a chat leaves in the thread for something it made, a toggle that opens the artifact in its panel.

props.name: title
props.description: The artifact's name. Collides with the native `title` tooltip attribute on purpose: the card shows its name, it does not hide it in a tooltip.

props.name: meta
props.description: A quiet line under the name: what kind of thing this is, or which version.

props.name: icon
props.description: The leading mark — Material Symbol name (string) or custom element (ReactNode).

props.name: open
props.description: Whether this card's artifact is on stage in its panel. The card holds the on-stage fill, announces itself pressed, and its trailing cue turns from open to close.
